summary.text: Brian Chavez is a member of the Ohio Senate, representing District 30, which covers Washington, Athens, Belmont, Meigs, Morgan, Monroe, Noble, Harrison and Jefferson counties and part of Guernsey County. The Senate's biography says he is serving his first full term, after being appointed to the Senate.

paragraphs.text: The Senate's biography says Chavez was born and raised in New Mexico, earned a degree in chemical engineering and worked for 12 years at Intel Corporation.

It says he and his wife, Christy, then moved to her hometown in Ohio and became involved in a family oil and gas business, and that the Marietta Area Chamber of Commerce named the couple Business Leaders of the Year in 2017.

Before his appointment to the Senate, Chavez was appointed by the governor to the Oil and Gas Commission, according to the biography, which also says he was a trustee of the Ohio Oil and Gas Association and president of the Southeast Ohio Oil and Gas Association.

It says that during the 135th General Assembly he championed legislation to help active-duty military members own homes in Ohio and sponsored the Senate legislation for the fifth State Capital Improvement Program.
It says he lives in Marietta with his wife and their two sons.
